name: bare-repo-name
about: #127: loop add --repo with a bare name (jarvis-node-mobile), an alias (mobile) or a slug stores the configured slug, so the runner finds the repo; a repo loopd is not configured with is refused at add, not left for the runner to fail on. The build runs in the mobile repo.

steps.title: A repo nobody configured
steps.refused: HTTP 400: .*jarvis-nope.* is not one loopd is configured with
